extends SceneTree
func _initialize() -> void: call_deferred("run")
func run() -> void:
	Catalog.load_all()
	assert(Catalog.rules.content_version==20 and Compatibility.content_hash()=="25f8b8a46258d7623cf91b1386073c7862c6a29d8ca2cb9a39ed3d16f61e13a8")
	var output := "res://tests/fixtures/content20/"
	assert(not FileAccess.file_exists(output+"manifest.json"),"freeze once, never replace historical fixtures")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output)
	var folder := "user://tests/freeze20-"+RaceSetup.uuid()
	var app: Node = load("res://game/client_app.gd").new()
	root.add_child(app)
	await process_frame
	app.data = AppData.new(folder,false)
	app.data.profile.display_name = "Archive 20"
	app.data.profile.first_run_complete = true
	assert(AppData.validate_profile(app.data.profile))
	assert(app.data.save_profile()==OK)
	assert(app.data.store.load_component("profile",{},AppData.validate_profile).display_name=="Archive 20")
	assert(app.data.start_cup()==OK)
	var hash := Compatibility.content_hash()
	app.data.records.times["trial:palm_bay:comet:"+hash] = {"time":0.1}
	assert(app.data.store.save_component("records",app.data.records)==OK)
	var samples: Array[Dictionary] = [{"time":0.0,"position":Vector3.ZERO,"yaw":0.0},{"time":0.05,"position":Vector3(0,0,1),"yaw":0.0},{"time":0.1,"position":Vector3(0,0,2),"yaw":0.0}]
	var ghost := GhostCodec.encode("palm_bay","comet",hash,0.1,samples)
	assert(not ghost.is_empty() and not GhostCodec.decode(ghost,"palm_bay","comet",hash).is_empty())
	var file := FileAccess.open(output+"ghost.bin",FileAccess.WRITE)
	file.store_buffer(ghost)
	file.close()
	app.start_drive({"mode":"quick","track":7,"car":0,"paint":0,"opponents":7,"laps":2,"difficulty":1,"contact":true,"seed":515005})
	app.drive.set_physics_process(false)
	await physics_frame
	await physics_frame
	for tick in range(600):
		var drive: RaceDrive = app.drive
		drive.session.step({drive.local_slot:drive.demo_driver.sample(drive.state,drive.car,drive.track,drive.query)})
	var archive := RaceArchive.capture(app.drive)
	assert(RaceArchive.valid(archive) and archive.content_hash==hash)
	assert(app.data.store.save_component("suspended_race",archive)==OK)
	var hashes: Dictionary = {}
	for name: String in ["profile.json","cup.json","records.json","suspended_race.json"]:
		var bytes := FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(app.data.store.root_path.path_join(name))
		file = FileAccess.open(output+name,FileAccess.WRITE)
		file.store_buffer(bytes)
		file.close()
		hashes[name] = FileAccess.get_sha256(output+name)
	hashes["ghost.bin"] = FileAccess.get_sha256(output+"ghost.bin")
	file = FileAccess.open(output+"manifest.json",FileAccess.WRITE)
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify({"schema_version":1,"source_commit":"44e498c","engine":"Godot 4.6.3","content_version":20,"content_hash":hash,"online_identity":"none created","purpose":"Frozen migration fixture: synthetic 0.1-second record/ghost and fresh Cup; actual 600-tick eight-car in-progress content-20 Quarry source race. No earned lap, result or performance claim.","files":hashes},"  ")+"\n")
	file.close()
	app.queue_free()
	await create_timer(.5).timeout
	assert(AppData.remove_tree(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(folder))==OK)
	print("FROZEN_CONTENT20_EXACT_CONFIGURATION_PROFILE_RECORD_GHOST_CUP_600_TICK_EIGHT_CAR_RACE_PASS")
	quit()
